set.body:
Owner directive (2026-09-01): "proceed with Qwen3 but we'll be flexible", after the recommendation of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the captioning proposal model with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct as the local-court variant.

What lands (documentation-only leg; nothing downloaded or executed)
- docs/design/vlm-captioning-admission-record.md: the ledger §3 ten-family record for caption.qwen3vl.8b (revision 0c351dd01ed8) and caption.qwen3vl.4b (revision ebb281ec70b0): identity (file trees with LFS digest prefixes, config digests, architecture and preprocessing parameters read from the pinned config files), rights (card licence apache-2.0, ungated; no LICENSE file at either revision, so the weights-licence leaf is HoldUnknown pending an owner decision), purpose and forbidden authority (Proposal only; cannot own time or self-accept; a caption is not a TimedSegment without a receipt-carrying adapter), the local adapter court and the §10.4 predeclared comparison (visual-only and late-fusion arms; a second model joins as an arm, never by substitution), preprocessing identity to declare per request (explicit frames, min/max pixels, mean/std 0.5, temporal patch 2, fixed prompt by digest, greedy decoding, bf16, no quantization), runtime candidates (mlx-vlm 0.6.17 / mlx 0.32.2 MIT; transformers 5.16.1 Apache-2.0), provenance and network posture (offline after a verified fetch; nothing leaves the machine), recheck triggers and remaining unknowns.
- Ledger: interpret.multimodal row annotated as superseded for the captioning court; two Nominated/RecipeOnly registry rows; §6.3 captioning-lane authorization with scope (components, inputs, outputs, and the realization gate on the weights-licence leaf).
- Rejected with reasons: Gemma 3 (gated), Qwen2.5-VL-3B (no licence tag), any remote API (Sherlock frames non-redistributable). Kept as later arms: InternVL3.5-8B and SmolVLM2-2.2B (Apache-2.0, ungated).

Not established
- No weights fetched, no worker written, no caption produced; the record is paperwork against public metadata read on 2026-09-01. The weights-licence leaf blocks realization until the owner records a decision. Training-data provenance is Unknown.
set.title: Captioning lane: admit Qwen3-VL-Instruct (8B nominated, 4B local court) by ten-family record; documentation-only leg
